profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a UC Berkeley graduate with a B.S. in Electrical Engineering and Computer Sciences (EECS), and a Senior Software Engineer with a strong foundation in game engine development for mobile and PC platforms. I began my career at a fast-paced gaming startup, quickly rising to a senior role where I led key engineering initiatives and contributed to several successful game launches.

Over the past two years, I've worked as a freelance software engineer, focusing on AI-related projects — particularly involving language models and natural language processing. This work has deepened my interest in intelligent systems and their potential across different industries.

I’m passionate about building scalable, efficient software and enjoy learning new technologies, diving into unfamiliar domains, and solving challenging problems. I thrive in environments where I can continuously broaden my knowledge and make a meaningful impact through code.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: •	Lead a team of engineers to create a mobile game engine allowing kids to create content from their phones without any programming.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Worked with a small team of designers and artists as a sole engineer to develop a metaverse game with over 183k plays on Reworld Platform.
•	Developed modular game system that can be integrated into other games with ease and efficiency saving.
•	Designed a system allowing automatic updates to content after a database update.  
•	Designed guidelines for new developers to allow them to create more efficient and clean code, and supported other teams with debugging issues.  
•	Implemented major updates and optimizations to older projects, including gameplay logic, Computer AI system logic, Server/Client Communications Logic, Data Storage Logic, and other gameplay functionalities. 
•	Created modules script templates for easy upgradeability as well as future developments to allow modification.

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Devised a detailed 2 month long outreach program, and lead a team of 8 people overseas for any types of work needed in various locations. 
• Spent over 9 months as a program staff in addition to 6 months as a volunteer member, including 5 months total overseas in Nepal, Thailand, Cambodia, and Vietnam.  
• Teamwork, cooperation, and communication played a key role.

projects.title: Home Design Web App Prototype (Javascript, HTML, CSS, Django)
projects.description:
• Created a web app prototype allowing users to visualize a home environment for decoration purposes. 
• Fully implemented 2-D space visualization and partial 3-D for users to freely move around objects within the space. 
• Implemented multi-device support in Django, allowing multiple users to update the same environment using their mobile devices as well as connecting to a larger display for easier collaboration.

projects.title: Personalized Phone Case Web App Prototype (Python, Javascript, HTML, CSS, Django)
projects.description:
• Created a web app that allowed users to personalize their phone cases using graphic interface. 
• Implemented art style transfer algorithm in the backend Django environment, which allowed users to transform their medium into any art style they wanted using any image or artwork. 
• Invested over 100+ hours on going through many design cycles for its UI as well as user tests.
